leaves.name: deligneCanonicalModelY3EveryPrint
leaves.doc: Shimura 1967 Main Theorem I in Deligne's form (Sem. Bourbaki 389, sections 4-5; Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties, sections 5-8 and 12-14) for Y3 = Sh_K3(B^x, H^pm), B = (2,-3|Q), stated as the print states it, for every witness (Y, Phi) of the printed fine-moduli clause list Y3Fix.R1fpPropsAbP: Psi : H^pm x (B (x) A_f)^x -> Y(C) onto with fibres exactly the print's double cosets B^x \ (H^pm x G(A_f) / K3) (DCRelPM); holomorphic in tau in H for every g; at [tau, u], u in O-hat^x (L_u = O), the abelian surface A with (H_1(A, Z), iota_*, h_A) = (O, left multiplication, h_tau) in genuine form (IsHodgeH1Print: H_1 = pi_1(A(C), 0)^ab for the classical topology, O acting by functoriality, the complex structure of Lie A through a holomorphic homomorphism e = exp_A o L, right multiplication by J_tau); Shimura's reciprocity law at CM points of H (conventions existential). The old field deligneCanonicalModelY3EveryH is proved from it (Y3Hodge.deligneH_of_print: restriction to H by exists_upper and dcRelPM_iff, H_1 dictionary print_iff_hodge). Consequence form: bijective and holomorphic in place of the biholomorphism, moduli clause at O-hat^x without polarization (unique: Y3Hodge Lemma P on H_1) and level structure, reciprocity at CM points of H
leaves.flag: pending review (new leaf, GLUE until a reviewer rates it): y3-hodge restatement of deligneCanonicalModelY3EveryH as its print (queue11 items: genuine H_1(A(C), Z) via pi_1^ab and exp_A, proved equivalent to IsHodgeH1; Lemma P on H_1; H^pm with B^x versus H with B^x_+, proved; sign of h fixed by holomorphy of F^0, proved); locators UNVERIFIED; reading risk (locators.md R1): the print is the polarized PEL problem over E(G,X) = Q
leaves.source: Shimura, Ann. of Math. 85 (1967), Main Theorem I; Deligne, Travaux de Shimura, Sem. Bourbaki 389 (1971) sections 4-5 (Cor. 5.7, Ex. 5.8); Milne, Introduction to Shimura varieties (2005) sections 5-8, 12-14; at B = (2,-3|Q), level K3, as a consequence; locators UNVERIFIED
